name: hold
_note: a hand HOLDING a rail or a chair's top for balance, seen side-on: the palm on top, the wrist in line with the forearm, the fingers wrapped over and down its far side, the thumb round the near side out of sight. With fx.fingersIn 1. 'drape' (the wrist dropped, the fingers dangling past the post) read 'not holding the chair' (Harry, round 8). Round 9: HOOKED at the knuckles (85°), the middle and end joints nearly straight (20°, 0°), the fingers together, so they fall down the post's front as one curve under the palm; curled 50–63° at every joint they bunched into 'a cluster of lumps… paws on a stick' (round 8, every lens). Picked beside the still with side_zoom.py --try
